component.name: Brutal Morrowind
component.summary: Morrowind with Dark Messiah style melee combat

description.p: Brutal Morrowind is a fork of the OpenMW engine that brings Dark Messiah of Might and Magic style first-person melee combat to Morrowind: kicks, ragdolls, slides, parries, finishers and adrenaline.
You need your own copies of Morrowind and Dark Messiah of Might and Magic.
